blurb:
Enjoy an exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime experience found only in Houston, where the story of space exploration comes alive through the eyes of a veteran astronaut.

Begin with an elegant brunch catered by Wolfgang Puck Catering, followed by a captivating presentation and private Q&A session with your guest astronaut. Hear firsthand stories, gain rare insight into life in space, and connect with one of the pioneers of human exploration.As a special memento, each guest receives a personalized photograph from the astronaut—a keepsake of an extraordinary encounter.

This unique experience also includes General Admission for the NASA Space Center allowing your group to explore the remarkable legacy of NASA and human spaceflight once breakfast is over! Finish your day with an amazing tour of the NASA Rocket Park —the very place where Apollo 11's famous Saturn V rocket lies for observation. 

Exclusive. Inspiring. Unforgettable. A truly unique Houston experience you won’t find anywhere else.
